title: Upper bounds for the average size of maximal matchings in bicyclic graphs
summary: For a graph $G$, let avm($G$) denote the average size of its maximal matchings. Engbers and Erey initiated the extremal study of this parameter and asked for extensions from trees and unicyclic graphs to $k$-cyclic graphs. In this paper, we determine the maximum value of avm($G$) over all connected bicyclic graphs with $n$ vertices and $n+1$ edges. If $n\ge 5$ is odd, then \[ \text{avm}(G)\le \frac{n-1}{2}, \] and we characterize all graphs attaining equality. For $n=6$, the maximum value is 13/5, attained uniquely by $Θ(1,3,3)$.
